Khoj | AI second brain that answers from your documents and the web

summary.one_liner: Khoj is a self-hostable AI "second brain" app that answers questions from the web and your own documents and lets you chat with local or cloud LLMs.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Khoj as a personal AI app that chats with any local or online LLM (it names llama3, qwen, gemma, mistral, gpt, claude, gemini, and deepseek). It can answer from internet sources and from user docs, including image, PDF, markdown, org-mode, Word, and Notion files, using semantic search. Users can reach it from a browser, Obsidian, Emacs, desktop, phone, or WhatsApp. It supports custom agents with their own knowledge, persona, chat model, and tools, plus scheduled automations such as newsletters and notifications. The README also mentions image generation, voice input/output, and deep research. Khoj can run privately on your own computer or be used through the hosted cloud app.
use_cases: chat with my own documents and notes
semantic search over PDFs and markdown notes
query Obsidian or Emacs notes with an LLM
build custom AI agents with specific knowledge
how_to_run: Read the self-hosting instructions in the Khoj docs (linked from the README)
notable: Works with both local LLMs and cloud models such as GPT, Claude, and Gemini
Integrates with Obsidian, Emacs, browser, desktop, phone, and WhatsApp
Custom agents with their own knowledge, persona, model, and tools
Scheduled automations and personal newsletters delivered to your inbox
caveats: The README points to external docs for self-hosting setup; no install commands are given in the README itself
A cloud-hosted version is offered as an alternative to self-hosting; enterprise on-premises and hybrid options are sold separately
